senses.gloss:
औडुपिक m. (-कः) A passenger, one going in a raft or boat.
 E. उडुप
and ठक् aff.

औडुम्बर mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
 1. Coppery, made of copper, &c.
 2. Made of the
wood of the Udumbara fig tree.
 m. (-रः) A name of YAMA the
regent of death.
 n. (-रं)
 1. A kind of leprosy.
 2. Copper.
 E. उडुम्बर
and अण् affix: see उडुम्बर, उदुम्बर, &c.
